propositions: Test intermittently fails under xdist when run with worksteal distribution because the rebar_reconciler root logger level is leaked process-globally by the reconciler entrypoint and not restored between tests.

The assertion expects a summary line at INFO level 'declined 1 inbound link removal' but only captures per-item WARNING 'declining the inbound removal of ...' because caplog.at_level(INFO) without logger= argument raises only the root logger, not the intermediate rebar_reconciler logger, causing INFO records to be filtered before handlers see them.

The existing log containment guard in tests/conftest.py is hard-coded to restore only the 'rebar' root logger, missing the sibling 'rebar_reconciler' root documented in src/rebar/_logging.py as a shared logger that needs containment.

Reproducing the failure is deterministic when test_main_entry.py runs before test_inbound_removal_confirmation_a4bd.py without randomization, proving the pollution is order-dependent and caused by test-level logger manipulation, not production code.

The fix generalizes the caplog guard to restore both rebar and rebar_reconciler root logger levels at test teardown by replacing scalar REBAR_LOGGER_NAME with SHARED_LOGGER_NAMES tuple and updating primitives to operate over all shared roots.
